caption: The drawing shows two views of a round ceramic plate. The upper part of the image displays the top view of the plate, which has a greenish surface and features a decorative design with three large, red-brown flowers and green leaves connected by curving stems. One of the flowers is positioned in the center, with the other two arranged diagonally above and below it. The design is accented with darker outlines. Near the bottom-left of the plate’s top view, the number "1823" is inscribed in black. The rim of the plate is a reddish-brown color, creating a border around the edge. The lower part of the drawing shows a side profile of the plate, depicting its shallow, concave shape and brown exterior. The background is plain and the plate is centered within the frame.
title: Pa. German Plate
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
